---
title: "Workshops"
execute:
  message: false
  warning: false
---

This page lists Bioconductor training events, including workshops delivered directly by the Bioconductor community, community-run Carpentries workshops, and selected external training opportunities.

For more information on our [Carpentries programme](/collaborations/carpentries/workshops.qmd), see the Carpentries workshop page. For Bioconductor-Physalia courses and information on free places for participants from low- and middle-income countries, see the [Physalia collaboration page](/collaborations/physalia/index.qmd).

New workshops can be added by submitting a pull request to update the [workshops TSV](https://github.com/Bioconductor/bioconductor-training/blob/devel/data/workshops.tsv).

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(countrycode)

workshops <- read_tsv("../data/workshops.tsv")

# Function to determine workshop status and return parsed date
determine_status_and_date <- function(date_str, initiative) {
  parsed_date <- NA_real_ # Initialize as numeric for date
  base_status <- "upcoming"

  if (grepl("TBD|Early|Late", date_str, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    base_status <- "upcoming"
    parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31") # Assign a very late date for TBD to push them to the end
  } else {
    # Attempt to parse the date
    # Try to parse as a date range (e.g., "24-28 March 2025")
    if (grepl("-\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}", date_str)) {
      end_date_str <- str_extract(date_str, "\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$")
      parsed_date <- dmy(end_date_str, quiet = TRUE)
    }
    # Handle comma-separated dates (e.g., "1, 8, 15, 22 June 2022")
    else if (grepl("\\d{1,2},\\s*\\d{1,2},\\s*\\d{1,2},\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}", date_str)) {
      last_date_part <- str_extract(date_str, "\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$")
      parsed_date <- dmy(last_date_part, quiet = TRUE)
    }
    # Handle year-only dates (e.g., "2022")
    else if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", date_str)) {
      parsed_date <- ymd(paste0(date_str, "-12-31"), quiet = TRUE)
    }
    # Handle single dates or month-year (e.g., "24 March 2025", "March 2024")
    else {
      parsed_date <- dmy(date_str, quiet = TRUE)
      if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
        parsed_date <- my(date_str, quiet = TRUE)
      }
    }

    # If date parsing still failed, default to upcoming and a very late date
    if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
      base_status <- "upcoming"
      parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31")
    } else {
      # Determine base status (upcoming or past)
      base_status <- if (parsed_date >= today()) {
        "upcoming"
      } else {
        "past"
      }
    }
  }

  # Apply Physalia-specific status if applicable and still upcoming
  if (base_status == "upcoming" && initiative == "Physalia") {
    status_out <- "applications-open"
  } else {
    status_out <- base_status
  }

  return(list(status = status_out, parsed_date = parsed_date))
}

# Apply the function and extract results
status_and_date_results <- mapply(determine_status_and_date, workshops$date, workshops$initiative, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

workshops <- workshops %>%
  mutate(
    status = map_chr(status_and_date_results, "status"),
    sort_date = map(status_and_date_results, "parsed_date") %>% unlist() %>% as.Date()
  ) %>%
  mutate(display_status = case_when(
    status == "applications-open" ~ "Upcoming",
    status == "upcoming" ~ "Upcoming",
    TRUE ~ "Past"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create a clickable title link based on conditions
    title_html = case_when(
      # Physalia with previous edition link
      initiative == "Physalia" & !is.na(previous_edition_url) & previous_edition_url != "" ~
        paste0(title, ' (<a href="', previous_edition_url, '" target="_blank">View Previous Edition</a>)'),
      # All other cases with a workshop URL
      !is.na(workshop_url) & workshop_url != "" ~
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', workshop_url, title),
      # All other cases without a workshop URL
      TRUE ~ title
    ),
    location_name_html = case_when(
      initiative == "Physalia" ~ '<a href="https://www.physalia-courses.org/" target="_blank">Physalia-courses</a>',
      !is.na(location_url) & location_url != "" ~ sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', location_url, location_name),
      TRUE ~ location_name
    ),
    city = if_else(initiative == "Physalia", "Online", city),
    country = if_else(initiative == "Physalia", "Online", country),
    region = if_else(initiative == "Physalia", "Online", countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "region")),
    initiative_html = case_when(
      initiative == "Bioconductor" ~ "Bioconductor",
      initiative == "Carpentries" ~ '<a href="/collaborations/carpentries/index.html">Carpentries</a>',
      initiative == "Physalia" ~ '<a href="/collaborations/physalia/index.html">Physalia</a>',
      TRUE ~ initiative
    )
  )

# Define common columns for both tables
common_columns <- list(
  date = colDef(name = "Date"),
  title_html = colDef(name = "Workshop", html = TRUE),
  initiative_html = colDef(name = "Initiative", html = TRUE),
  location_name_html = colDef(name = "Host / Partner", html = TRUE),
  city = colDef(name = "City"),
  country = colDef(name = "Country"),
  region = colDef(name = "Region"),
  instructors = colDef(name = "Instructors")
)

# Filter data for Upcoming and Past workshops
upcoming_workshops_data <- workshops %>%
  filter(display_status == "Upcoming") %>%
  arrange(sort_date) %>%
  select(date, title_html, initiative_html, location_name_html, city, country, region, instructors)

past_workshops_data <- workshops %>%
  filter(display_status == "Past") %>%
  arrange(desc(sort_date)) %>%
  select(date, title_html, initiative_html, location_name_html, city, country, region, instructors)

# Create Upcoming Workshops table
upcoming_table <- reactable(
  upcoming_workshops_data,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  columns = common_columns,
  defaultExpanded = TRUE # Expanded by default
)

# Create Past Workshops table
past_table <- reactable(
  past_workshops_data,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  columns = common_columns,
  defaultExpanded = FALSE # Collapsed by default
)

# Combine tables with headings
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::h2("Upcoming Workshops"),
  upcoming_table,
  htmltools::h2("Past Workshops"),
  past_table
)
```
